item.title: She Trusted The Wrong English Student
item.description: Lindsay Hawker was a 22-year-old British teacher living in Tokyo when she was murdered in 2007 after accepting a private English lesson. Her killer, Tatsuya Ichihashi, fled and evaded capture for more than two years before being arrested and later sentenced to life in prison. The case shocked both Japan and the United Kingdom.
